dogecoin.text: Well it's official, #dogecoin is now worth three times as much as the entire combined publicly traded market cap of the #uranium sector. This makes sense, because one provides the irreplaceable fuel for ~10% of the world's electricity generation and the other is a literal meme...

Seeing moves like the ones we saw in $AMC today and #Dogecoin before make me both very nervous about the state of the broad equities market, as well as peaking my interest regarding what euphoria and massive amounts of speculative capital can do.
